title: Your Chance to Own a Piece of India's Coal Giant: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO Explained
description: Mahanadi Coalfields, a big government-owned coal company, has launched its Initial Public Offering (IPO). You can apply for shares between November 19 and Nov.

faq.q: What is the issue size of the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO?
faq.a: The total issue size for the Mahanadi Coalfields IPO is ₹8,981.12 crore.

Anchor investors are large institutional investors (like mutual funds, insurance companies, or foreign institutions) who subscribe to shares a day before the IPO opens to the public. Their participation helps build confidence in the IPO.

faq.q: How do I apply for the IPO?
faq.a: You can apply for the IPO through your bank's ASBA (Application Supported by Blocked Amount) facility or through your stockbroker's platform using UPI.

faq.q: What is the parent company of Mahanadi Coalfields?
faq.a: Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, a major public sector undertaking.

faq.q: When will the shares be listed?
faq.a: The shares of Mahanadi Coalfields are tentatively scheduled to be listed on November 27, 2026, on both the BSE and NSE.
